newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 96/97 surplus seen up to HK$30 bln - Peat Marwick.
newsitem.headline: HK 96/97 surplus seen up to HK$30 bln - Peat Marwick.

text.p: Hong Kong will post a budget surplus of between HK$25 billion and HK$30 billion for the 1996/97 fiscal year ending March 31, Peat Marwick said in a statement on Friday.
The company's estimate far exceeds the government's forecast of HK$1.6 billion.
Peat Marwick also said it estimated Hong Kong's cash reserves would be in excess of HK$173 billion, or over HK$27,000 per capita by March 31, 1997.
"We believe that it is imperative for Hong Kong to keep pace with the development of services and products offered by the financial service industry," the statement said.
